Questions

What associations ask about the AMS Connector

Do we need an AMS API?

No. The Lite, Standard and Advanced tiers work from scheduled exports from your AMS, so there is nothing to integrate.

How often does data sync?

From once a day to near real time, depending on your tier.

How do you prevent duplicate contacts?

Every record is matched on a unique ID, usually the AMS Member ID, and merged IDs are handled automatically.

Do synced contacts count as marketing contacts?

No. They arrive as non-marketing contacts, and you decide which ones become marketing contacts.

What does our team do each day?

Most days, nothing. The nightly report lists anything that needs a fix, and most fixes take a non-technical staff member a few minutes.

Which Association Management Solutions does the Connector support?

Ricochet has built connectors for Aptify, Fonteva, GrowthZone, Higher Logic, iMIS, MemberClicks, MemberSuite, netFORUM, Nimble, Novi AMS, Personify, Protech, re:Members, Rhythm, Thrive, Wild Apricot, and YourMembership. Nearly all AMS platforms are compatible, including heavily customized implementations. Contact Ricochet to confirm your AMS.

Is the data sync one-way or two-way?

Both! While most associations start with a one-way sync from their AMS to HubSpot, the Connector can establish a two-way sync for select AMS solutions.

What data can be synced besides contact information?

Most AMS data types can be synched through the AMS Connector. This includes standard contact info as well as critical association data like membership status, renewal dates, event registrations, committee memberships, donation history, and certifications.

We have a lot of custom fields in our AMS. Can those be synced?

Absolutely. The Connector is designed to map your custom AMS fields to corresponding custom properties in HubSpot, so your unique data is always available to your marketing team.

Can I change the data I sync?

Yes. Your association's needs will change, and your AMS Connector can change with you. We can easily adjust the synchronization using your allocated support hours.

How long does it take to launch?

Our standard implementation is incredibly fast. Once the project kicks off, Ricochet can have most clients fully configured, tested, and launched in as little as two weeks.

How tech-savvy do I need to be?

Not at all. This is a "done-for-you" service. Our integration specialists handle all the technical configuration, data mapping, and testing. You just need to tell us what data you want to move.

What kind of support is included with the subscription?

All subscription tiers include our standard email support, handled by Ricochet's integration experts. The response time for your request differs depending on your subscription tier.

What happens if our AMS has an update or downtime?

The Connector is built with safeguards and error logging. If a sync fully fails, you will receive an automated email alert and the Connector will retry at the next scheduled synchronization time.

Can I reduce expenses by implementing the HubSpot AMS Connector?

Yes. The most significant cost saving is the elimination of labor costs for manual HubSpot imports. Associations spend up to 20 hours every month manually exporting CSVs from their AMS, cleaning and formatting spreadsheets, checking for errors, and importing them into HubSpot, and the Connector eliminates that effort.

Can I generate more revenue with the Connector?

Yes, the Connector allows you to instantly trigger time-sensitive sales, marketing, and service messages, like renewal reminders, new member upsells, or event promotions, at the exact moment they will have the most impact. By equipping your sales and service teams with this real-time data, you can close more sales, act on opportunities faster, and improve member retention.

How is AMS Connector subscription pricing determined?

Our flexible subscription tiers ensure you only pay for what you need. Our tiers increase in price based on synchronization volume and complexity. Contact Ricochet for detailed pricing information.

Is there a one-time Connector implementation fee?

Yes. The implementation fee covers the entire guided onboarding process to ensure your Connector is set up correctly from day one. Contact Ricochet for detailed pricing information.

Why can't I just use HubSpot's import function or a tool like Zapier?

HubSpot's import tool is manual, time-consuming, and can't run automatically. Tools like Zapier are great for simple, one-to-one "if-this-then-that" triggers but lack the robustness to handle the complex, multi-field logic required for a full AMS integration. Our Connector is a purpose-built, enterprise-grade solution designed specifically for the deep, complex data models of associations.

Why do AMS syncs with HubSpot fail?

Rarely because of the technology. The sync runs, but nobody owns it, nobody watches it and errors pile up until staff stop trusting the data. The Ricochet AMS Connector sends a daily status report to your owner, heals records that fail, and runs a monthly true-up of every record, matched on your AMS Member ID.

How do we stop manually exporting member lists from our AMS?

Automate the move. The Ricochet AMS Connector picks up scheduled exports from your AMS and syncs contacts, companies and custom objects into HubSpot, from once a day to near real time depending on your tier. Most tiers need no AMS API, and your staff stop exporting, uploading and retyping member data.

What is the best AMS to use with HubSpot?

The one that fits your membership model. Nearly any AMS can work with HubSpot, because what matters most is how member data moves between them. The Ricochet AMS Connector works with nearly all AMS platforms and most tiers need no AMS API. If you are choosing a new AMS, a technology roadmap compares the options.
